fr_html: A cette occasion, M. FERNANDES reprend son amendement aux articles 25 et 26 du projet Root—Phillimore, visant l'élargissement du rôle des juges suppléants, amendement qui, lors de la discussion de ces textes, avait été renvoyé à la seconde lecture.
en_html: At this point, M. FERNANDES again put forward his amendment to Articles 25 and 26 of the Root—Phillimore plan, which was intended to increase the part played by the deputy-judges; this amendment was, at the time of the discussion of these clauses, postponed to the second reading.
